description: Gold sales-order lifecycle as Portal's rail builds it (buildOrderLifecycle; for a FileMaker order with no gold twin, synthesizeFmOrderLifecycle from the OE header status): sales order, then for MAKE manufacturing order and release order, then pick list; DISTRIBUTE skips the manufacturing and release steps (MRP-M-154). Pick gate: MAKE needs a RELEASED or FULFILLED ship release, DISTRIBUTE needs the order confirmed. Shipment confirmation is gated per line, not per header (confirm/route.ts shipmentSkipsShipRelease): a DISTRIBUTE order with any MAKE line still needs a ship release to ship, although buildOrderLifecycle still says DISTRIBUTE skips release (see the shipment stage and condition order_has_make_line). Shipment and customer invoice follow the rail (O2C steps 4-6 of the BC transaction mapping brief); they are Workbench stages evidenced by declared ontology links, not Portal rail steps. Quantities: ordered vs shipped vs invoiced per item (order_fulfilment_match). The quote head step is omitted: its evidence (customFields.sourceQuoteId) is not a declared property. Re-read at staging 38cd3f3: the rail ends with Shipment and Complete steps read from the order status (SHIPPED or COMPLETE), which only the Portal close-out sets (999dac8 TASK-2396; it can also restate a made line to its realized yield and short-close a remainder in custom_fields.closeout, which this graph does not read, so a short-closed remainder still reads as a shortfall); the shipment stage stays evidence-based. Authority: a Portal MAKE order confirmed from then on has no FileMaker order_entry (898e084 TASK-2638) and its releases and shipments key on portal ids (8665d4d TASK-2641: ShipRelease.sales_order_id canonical, order_ref a compatibility ref); the FileMaker root and the same_record_as paths serve only legacy orders the Portal still reads.

variants.label: Distribution (rail: no release step; shipping with a MAKE line still needs one)

conditions.description: A RELEASED or FULFILLED ship release authorises the warehouse to pick (RELEASE_CLEARS_PICK, some()).

The order has at least one Produce (MAKE) line. Portal's confirm route skips the ship-release gate only when the header is DISTRIBUTE and no allocated line is MAKE (shipmentSkipsShipRelease), so a DISTRIBUTE order with a MAKE line needs a ship release to ship. Portal reads the allocated lines of the shipment; the order's lines are the closest declared evidence.

stages.label: Sales order
stages.description: The order is confirmed: status in SO_CONFIRMED, its legacy alias Open, or COMPLETE (CANCELLED ignored); a FileMaker order is read by its own OE header status.

evidence.note: SO_CONFIRMED plus OPEN and COMPLETE. Open is the legacy FileMaker-import status the Portal reads as CONFIRMED (portal/src/lib/sales-order/status.ts normalizeSalesOrderStatus; evals/oracle/keys.py SO_STATUS_ALIASES). SO_CONFIRMED holds COMPLETE since 999dac8 (order-lifecycle.ts@38cd3f3); a completed order is a commitment, not a draft: reading either as one would leave its quantities uncompared and hide a shortfall. CANCELLED is ignored (no live order: missing with no_live_record, never a draft).

FM order as root: Portal's rail synthesizes its lane from the OE header status when no gold order bridges it (synthesizeFmOrderLifecycle@790256c; blank reads DRAFT). The rail tests it against SO_CONFIRMED, which holds no FM status text; the Workbench reads Open and Closed as committed (see the gold note) and Cancelled as no order. A gold root never reads this spec. Portal assumes MAKE; FM carries no mode, so the variant stays unknown. Legacy only since 898e084 TASK-2638 (38cd3f3): a newly confirmed Portal MAKE order has no FileMaker twin.

stages.label: Manufacturing order
stages.description: Every live manufacturing order of the order's lines is done (MO_DONE, every(); CANCELLED ignored).

prerequisites.note: The order's manufacturing step waits on each live manufacturing order of its lines being realized (MO_DONE) in the manufacturing department's own process, whose blockers (materials) it inherits.

evidence.note: Soft-deleted MOs (deleted_at set) are dropped as Portal's loader does.

stages.label: Release order
stages.description: Every live ship release is FULFILLED (RELEASE_DONE, every(); CANCELLED ignored).

evidence.note: The single-order loader reads releases by salesOrderId and adds those whose orderRef is the order's FM id only when none carries that orderRef; the list loader (attachListLifecycles) always unions both, deduplicated by id; here both paths are a union (deduplicated by record), so a release found only through the FM id counts even then. Ship releases exist only as Portal-native rows (lineage gold_native_staging under fulfillment.json), so on today's data a release is a lead: this stage and the release_clears_pick gate are unknown until such rows are confirmed.

stages.label: Pick list
stages.description: Every live pick list is COMPLETED (PICK_DONE, every(); CANCELLED ignored).

evidence.note: app_pick_list is not served by the reporting API, so this stage is unknown, never missing.

stages.source_note: pickGate: MAKE clears on a RELEASED/FULFILLED release; DISTRIBUTE clears once the order is confirmed.

stages.label: Shipment
stages.description: A shipment of the order went out: a gold shipment SHIPPED or DELIVERED, or a posted Sage/BC shipment record. An FM-kept order proves no absence (absence_unproven): unknown, never missing.

evidence.note: ShipmentStatus (portal/prisma/schema.prisma): DRAFT, CONFIRMED, PICKING, PACKED, SHIPPED, DELIVERED, CANCELLED.
A Sage OE shipment or a BC posted sales shipment exists only once shipped.

absence_unproven.note: an order kept in FM: FM shipments reach the Portal as app_shipment rows with no sales_order_id, so no shipment record links to the order and its absence proves nothing

stages.source_note: Confirm gate (confirm/route.ts, MRP-M-133): a shipment needs a RELEASED ship release unless shipmentSkipsShipRelease (header DISTRIBUTE and no allocated line is MAKE). A MAKE header always needs one; a DISTRIBUTE header with a MAKE line too (condition order_has_make_line). Not enforced as `requires`: it is per variant and the graph cannot express 'only when a MAKE line exists'. Since fe53eec TASK-2701 the gate also reads a builder line's own source; it never reads the order's releaseRequired (1e40b64 TASK-2400).

stages.label: Customer invoice
stages.description: A customer invoice bills the order (BC posts it; Sage history). Draft and cancelled invoices do not count (document-finance.ts classifyInvoice).

evidence.note: BC invoices reach a gold order only through a lead (externalDocumentNumber text match) or through the order's verified BC twin; leads never count as evidence.
A Sage OE invoice header is a posted invoice (historic books).

quantity_checks.description: Per item (records joined only by verified/reviewed Product.same_record_as): ordered vs shipped quantity (one-sided, exact, as Portal's open quantity), shipped vs invoiced quantity, order unit price vs invoice unit price. Only SHIPPED/DELIVERED shipments' lines are shipped (in-progress: reported, never summed); draft and cancelled invoices do not count. The order's own system of record first; its twins' only when it has none, and one system per item (several twins' lines are a conflict, never a sum). Lead (text) links are never counted. Units and currencies must agree; nothing is converted.
